title: a quota error with no reset takes the fallback edge exactly once
proves: a worker exhaustion envelope with error code quota_exhausted and no resetAt classifies as an outright failover (quotaResetSchedule has nothing to wait on) rather than a wait, and planRoute spends the runtime's one declared fallback hop: the node finishes on the fallback runtime, never re-attempting the exhausted primary, and records exactly one routing-history hop. The replay driver's own canonicalization keeps only error.code and error.message off a recorded envelope (see replay.mjs's canonicalError) and drops any resetAt a recording might carry, so a replay-driven quota envelope can only ever exercise this no-reset branch, never the scheduled-reset one.

contract.goal: prove a quota error with no reset takes the declared fallback edge exactly once
